neighbours.label: A function word written in ALL CAPS for emphasis inside otherwise lower-case prose (TO, FOR, IS, ARE, BE, WE); the same word in lower case, capitalised content words, acronyms and 'NOT' are quiet. The - pole takes the capitalised negation/intensifier side (NOT, VERY, ever)
fire: Forget what the magazines say and choose the diet that is right FOR your own body.
She kept telling me that this job IS worth the long commute.
It may look silly to others, but it means a lot TO my family.
Believe me, there ARE people out there who will help you.
The gift was meant FOR him, not for his brother.
People keep asking what the real problem IS with the new plan.
You owe it TO yourself to take a proper holiday this year.
Whatever the critics claim, we ARE going ahead with the show.
quiet: Forget what the magazines say and choose the diet that is right for your own body.
She kept telling me that this job is WORTH the long COMMUTE.
It may look silly to others, but it means a LOT to my FAMILY.
Believe me, there are people at the BBC and the NHS who will help you.
The gift was NOT meant as a joke, whatever his brother says.
People keep asking what the real problem is with the new plan.
You owe it to yourself to take a PROPER holiday this year.
Whatever the critics claim, we will NEVER cancel the show.

notes: Card: ' IS' x6, ' ARE' x4, ' TO' x3, ' FOR' x2, ' BE' x2; the - pole is ' NOT' x19. Probes: matters TO me 0.99, works FOR you 0.88, everyone else IS missing 0.72, things ARE possible 0.32; lower-case 'for' 0.07, 'do NOT park' 0.00, caps content words POSSIBLE/HOURS 0.04, NASA/FBI 0.01.
